Breathwork

The technique

Conscious Connected Breathwork (CCB).

A Holotropic breathing practice, CCB can help us access what we carry beneath the surface and gently release what no longer needs to be held.

Every person breathes differently, so every session is unique. I simply create the space for you to listen inward.

You already hold what you need. Breathwork helps you hear it.

About me

Breathwork changed my life.

I have always wanted to help people. A few years ago, during a session in Portugal, I knew that it would be through breathwork that I would fulfil my desire to help. I had found myself, and I wanted to share this technique.

I’m not a yogi master or a Buddhist monk. I’m just Eliot, a French breathwork facilitator, full of life and curiosity. For several years now, I have been trying to understand human reasoning, emotions and trauma, through books, encounters and a lot of meditation. I’m convinced that all of this is learned by listening to ourselves honestly, and by talking with an open heart.

I’m a certified breathwork facilitator from Bodhi Breathwork, with Jean Rossouw in Hout Bay, Cape Town. Jean is a certified breathwork practitioner, facilitator and trainer, an Advanced Practitioner with Breathwork Africa, and a qualified yin yoga teacher. I have since practised breathwork in many countries in the world.

I believe peace, joy and light already live within us. Breathwork is simply a doorway back to them, back to who you truly are.

Book a session

Conscious Connected Breathwork can be a powerful practice.

Please do not book a session if you:

  • are pregnant
  • have glaucoma, a detached retina, or have had recent eye surgery
  • have a heart condition, high blood pressure, or a history of stroke or aneurysm
  • have epilepsy or a history of seizures
  • live with a severe mental health condition, such as psychosis or bipolar disorder
  • have severe osteoporosis, or have had recent surgery, an injury or a fracture
  • have a serious respiratory condition
  • are unwell with an acute illness or infection
  • have taken alcohol or recreational drugs on the day of the session

Every situation is different. If you have any other medical condition, please inform me before the session.
